
<!-- The following figures illustrate the Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS) for the actual soil site conditions of the project, in terms of spectral pseudo-accelerations  $S_a(T_n)$  for a 5% critical damping, and return periods from 100 to 10,000 years. -->


```{r echo=FALSE}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
TR_TARGET <- c(100,475,1000,2475,5000,10000)
CAP <-  "Horizontal seismic (pseudo-static) coefficients for %s in terms of peak-ground accelerations (Kh) for AEP ranging between 1/100 to 1/10,000 yr. All values were obtained assuming soil site conditions with  Vs30=%s  m/s and a maximum shear stiffness at the base of the slope of Go=%4.1f MPa (p=%s)"
```



## Seismic Coefficients for Rock Impoundment (RI)

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}

ID_TARGET <- "RI"
Name <- SHT[ID==ID_TARGET]$Name[1]
Go <- SHT[ID==ID_TARGET & level==p_TARGET]$Go
Caption <- CAP  |> sprintf(Name,Vs30_TARGET,Go,p_TARGET)
DATA <- KIT[ID==ID_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=paste0("TR= ",TR," yr"),Y=Kh,X=Da)][order(X)]|> unique()

PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="spline",
  point.size = 0.1,
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
  xAxis.legend="Da [cm]",
  yAxis.legend="Kh [% PGA]",
  group.legend="TR [yr]",
  data=DATA,
  plot.subtitle = Caption)
PLOT
```
